chapter: Family follow-ups from the first reels
title: Brother Ernie's start on trumpet
summary: Their uncle began Ernie on trumpet at about seven, then he studied with George Pacheco.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: How did your brother Ernie Royal happen to start playing trumpet?

My uncle Ernest gave him a trumpet and started him out, teaching him on the trumpet. So, my uncle Ernest was my brother Ernie's first teacher on the trumpet. After that, after he taught him all that he could teach him, he made arrangements to have a teacher that was formerly one of the solo trumpet players with Sousa's band and one of the lead trumpets with the Los Angeles Philharmonic, George Pacheco (PHONETIC). He was arranged as a teacher for my brother.
Pacheco -- yes, just about it. That's it.
How old was your brother when your uncle (inaudible)?
His first instrument and he sure sounded bad.
Well, he must have been a good student.

Yeah, he was a very good student. My uncle took him out the first year after he started to play his trumpet, to come all around the neighborhood at Christmastime, had him playing Christmas carols for all the people during the night when he was a tiny tot.
Oh, no, no, no. That was his project.
